worldcombat.skill.foulplay.summary: A shadow arm crawls into the target's shadow and raises a cluster of dark spines from under its own feet. This move ignores the user's Attack and reads the target's Attack instead: the stronger the foe, the harder it hits.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.description.0: The damage %1$s is driven by the target's current Attack: the stronger the foe, the higher the power; the user's own Attack barely matters.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.description.1: The shadow reaches %1$s blocks and crawls at %2$s blocks per tick; the grasp has a %3$s block radius and raises %4$s spines from the target's shadow.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.use.2: Drag a strong foe into melee
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.preference.cl: On: on a hit, drag the target closer and leave it staggering (slowed), but this hit is ×0.88 and the cooldown is 3 ticks longer. Off: the shadow only stabs upward, this hit is ×1.06.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in before reaching out. Higher reaches further targets first.
A target whose effective Attack reaches this value jumps ahead of other moves (one tier higher past it). Lower it to borrow strength from more targets.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.growth.0: From level %1$s: foul power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.growth.1: From level %1$s: foul power %2$s, shadow reach %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.cling.on: Cling: on a hit the shadow drags the target closer and leaves it staggering, this hit is held back.
worldcombat.skill.foulplay.cling.off: Foul: the shadow only stabs upward for maximum damage.
